A4988 bipolar stepper motor driver (STEP/DIR). Pulse STEP to advance one step; DIR sets the direction; MS1-MS3 select microstepping. Outputs 1A/1B (coil A) and 2A/2B (coil B) to a stepper's A+/A-/B+/B- terminals.

![A4988 Stepper Driver](../../../../assets/docs/parts/a4988.png)
